text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Canary health check FAILED for service: inference-api /v1/generate (deploy id: dpl-20251102-78). error_rate=7.8% (threshold 5%). Paging @oncall-ryan :rotating_light:

oncall-ryan: ack. ETA 5m. checking logs + canary dashboard.

sre-maria: taking secondary. any recent flag flips?

eng-lead-anya: FYI flipped feature flag `new-tokenizer` to true in canary at 02:10Z as part of tokenizer experiment.

oncall-ryan: auto-rollback attempted but got 409 Conflict: 'flag pinned by policy' — looks like rollout gating prevented rollback.

eng-lead-anya: ugh. initiating manual kill-switch for that flag. wait.

sre-maria: recommend warm-drain canary and pin traffic to stable.

oncall-ryan: running kill switch now:

```bash
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx' https://flags.internal/api/flip \\n  -d '{"flag":"new-tokenizer","state":"off","actor":"oncall-ryan"}'
```

incident-bot: FEATURE FLAG OFF: new-tokenizer set to false by oncall-ryan at 02:18Z

support-lee: customer impact — support queue shows 12 tickets with degraded completions; no auth errors. tagging affected customers in status page.

product-jamie: any hallucination/regression examples? high priority for billing flow.

sre-maria: sample: user prompt 'What is my balance?' -> model responded 'Total due $0' (incorrect).

oncall-ryan: starting manual rollback of canary build to previous image dpl-20251030-99

```bash
k rollout undo deployment/inference-canary --to-revision=20251030-99
```

eng-lead-anya: monitoring: smoke tests started. Please validate top-line: 5m error rate <1%, latency P95 < 150ms.

oncall-ryan: smoke test results:

```text
curl https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer ...' -d '{"prompt":"hello"}' -> 200 OK, coherent text.
metrics: error_rate=0.6%, p95=120ms
```

sre-maria: logs show KV-cache miss spike during tokenizer flip. clearing caches on canary nodes.

eng-lead-anya: after rollback and flag off, canary traffic ramped down to 0%. Metrics trending back to baseline.

support-lee: posted incident update to status.redwood.ai and emailed top 3 enterprise customers.

product-jamie: setting severity P1. postmortem owner @eng-lead-anya.

eng-lead-anya: will run regression eval on 50 prompt set and push model-verification report.

oncall-ryan: closing pager, will stay on to validate for 30m. creating follow-up ticket #INC-20251102-78.

incident-bot: Incident acknowledged closed by oncall-ryan at 02:28Z :white_check_mark:
